title: 第3章 亲弟弟第4章 圣旨
slug: 提前登陆游戏世界开局联姻女帝
content_zh:
庭院中。
春风带着几许寒意，夏辰心头无法宁静。
女帝，那可是【大一统】版本中，最强大的存在，威慑天下，八荒臣服，聚拢天下气运，立万世法！
随后凭借大一统气运，修建神庙，以大气魄，向天道发下宏愿，硬生生的将大武王朝提前化为气运王朝，大武境内，气运镇压一切。
至此，非大武臣民，皆为异端，修行速度缓慢，而拥有大武官职，根据品阶，可借助不同程度的王朝气运，加速修行。
天下英杰尽入彀中！
“这种情况，一直到【灵气复苏诸天融合】阶段，女帝消失不见，武朝气运崩坏，大一统分崩离析，天下英杰才从大武国运镇压中解放。
但潘多拉魔盒一旦打开，便再也不可回到过去，之后但凡一方王朝之主，都效仿女帝，以气运镇压境内，王朝气运成为修行补药，官职越高，修行速度越快，王朝之主更是好处最大……”
夏辰在仔细回想后面剧情，前世他只是把这个世界当做游戏在玩，因此前期并没有上心，很多都是走马观花。
但随着后面【诸天融合】版本开启，这方世界成为主世界，一切变得真实，他们玩家不再拥有不死之身，他才发觉不对劲。
“没听说过女帝有未婚夫啊！”
夏辰摇了摇脑袋，仔细回忆，试图凭借后面剧情推演出现如今的局面，但可惜，前世他进入这方世界已经是【大一统】版本前期了，没有人知道【文帝时期】还是二皇女身份的女帝，到底经历了什么。
“不对，大一统时期，镇东侯府依旧大放异彩，绽放出璀璨光芒，人杰层出不穷，我的那位亲弟弟夏昊拥有传说中的至尊骨，天赋异常惊人，在女帝时期更是成为了帝国之柱，成为大武开疆扩土最锋利的矛，立下了赫赫战功。
女帝有大气魄，破除祖制将我那亲弟弟封为镇东王。
但坊间却有小道消息，我那亲弟弟夏昊之所以能够封王那是因为女帝潜龙困渊之时，与镇东侯府一普通子弟有了婚约，但最终，这名侯府子弟在夺门之变中，血洒当场。
女帝登临帝位之后，婚约之事不了了之，但正是因为此事，女帝才会补偿夏家，对夏昊破格封王……”
原本夏辰一直以为这些事都只是坊间传闻，认为这些传闻不过是一些有心人诋毁女帝和镇东王的谣言。
但现在看来或许一切是真的，女帝与镇东侯府真的有一段过往，而那个侯府普通子弟，连名字都没在史书上留下来的人，便是他——夏辰。
“我的存在只是黑历史，不堪回首的过往吗，会给女帝的光辉形象抹上尘埃，所以连名字都不能拥有。”
夏辰自嘲的笑着，但眼神深处重瞳异象再次浮现，眸子仿佛日月交融，合二为一，丝丝缕缕的混沌气弥漫，眸子有冷冽寒光闪烁。

“这么说来，我的剧情到夺门之变便会杀青，难怪前世从来没有听说镇东侯府还有一名叫夏辰的嫡子，那个璀璨耀眼的帝国之柱夏昊有一个亲哥哥！”
夏辰神色重新变得平静，如同深渊之水，不起丝毫波澜。
他走进房屋中，自己穿好一套华服，原本院子中是有一些丫鬟的，但12岁之后，侯府便将这些丫鬟全都撤去了。
倒不是侯府看他幼小，便欺凌他，而是侯府所有子弟都是这样的，在未踏入八品之前，练武之人最忌讳破身。
但练武又气血方刚的，整天美貌的丫鬟在身边环绕，难免会品尝禁果，影响后续前程。
夏辰刚一踏出庭院，便有一个身穿碧绿罗裳裙，年芳二八的美丽女子步履款款向夏辰走来。
“碧珠！”
夏辰认识这个女子。
“三少爷，老爷和夫人喊您过去。”
碧珠在夏辰面前停下行了一礼，态度恭敬，并没有如电视剧那般恃宠而骄，看不起这个在侯府中有些小透明的少爷。
content_en:
In the courtyard.
The spring breeze carried a bit of chill, and Xia Chen couldn't feel at peace.
The Empress is the most powerful existence in the [Great Unification] version. She can intimidate the world, make the world surrender, gather the destiny of the world, and establish laws for all generations!
Later, relying on the unification of luck, he built temples, made great aspirations for the way of heaven with great courage, and forcibly turned the Dawu Dynasty into the Qi Luck Dynasty in advance. Within the territory of Dawu, luck suppressed everything.
At this point, all non-Dawu subjects are heretics and their cultivation speed is slow. However, those who hold the rank of Dawu official can speed up their cultivation with the help of varying degrees of dynasty luck according to their rank.
All the heroes in the world are here!
“This situation lasted until the [Spiritual Qi Resurrection and Fusion of All Heavens] stage, when the empress disappeared, the Wu Dynasty’s destiny collapsed, and the great unification fell apart, and the heroes of the world were liberated from the suppression of the Wu Dynasty’s destiny.
But once Pandora's box is opened, there is no way to go back to the past. After that, all the heads of a dynasty will imitate the empress and use luck to suppress the territory. The luck of the dynasty becomes a tonic for cultivation. The higher the official position, the faster the cultivation speed, and the leader of the dynasty has the greatest benefits..."
Xia Chen was carefully thinking about the subsequent plot. In his previous life, he just treated the world as a game, so he didn't pay much attention to it in the early stage and mostly just watched it.
But as the later version of [Fusion of Heavens] opened, this world became the main world, everything became real, and their players no longer had immortality, he realized something was wrong.
"I've never heard of the empress having a fiancé!"
Xia Chen shook his head, recalled carefully, and tried to deduce the current situation based on the subsequent plot, but unfortunately, he entered this world in the previous life in the early stage of the [Great Unification] version, and no one knew what the empress experienced during the [Era of Emperor Wen] when she was still the second princess.
"No, during the great unification period, the Zhendong Hou Mansion still shined brightly, with outstanding people emerging one after another. My biological brother Xia Hao possesses the legendary Supreme Bone, and his talent is amazing. During the period of the Empress, he became the pillar of the empire, the sharpest spear for Dawu to expand its territory, and made great military exploits.
The empress had the courage to break the ancestral system and make my younger brother the King of Zhendong.
But there are rumors in the market that the reason why my biological brother Xia Hao was able to become the king was because when the empress Qianlong was trapped in the abyss, she had a marriage contract with an ordinary child of the Zhendong Hou Mansion. However, in the end, this child of the Hou Mansion shed blood on the spot during the coup.
After the Empress ascended the throne, the engagement matter was settled, but it was precisely because of this incident that the Empress compensated the Xia family and granted Xia Hao the title of king..."
Originally, Xia Chen always thought that these things were just rumors, thinking that these rumors were just rumors slandered by some well-intentioned people to slander the empress and King Zhendong.
But now it seems that maybe everything is true, the empress really has a past with the Zhendong Hou Mansion, and that ordinary child of the Hou Mansion, whose name has not even been left in the history books, is him - Xia Chen.
"Is my existence just a dark history, a past that is unbearable to look back on? It will put dust on the glorious image of the empress, so I can't even have a name."
Xia Chen laughed self-deprecatingly, but the double-eyed phenomenon reappeared deep in his eyes. His eyes seemed to merge with the sun and the moon, merging into one, filled with strands of chaotic energy, and there was a cold light shining in his eyes.
"In this way, my plot will be completed when it comes to seizing the gate. No wonder I never heard in my previous life that there was a legitimate son named Xia Chen in the Zhendong Marquis Mansion. That dazzling pillar of the empire, Xia Hao, has a biological brother!"
Xia Chen's expression became calm again, like water in the abyss, without any ripples.
He walked into the house and put on a set of fine clothes. Originally there were some maids in the yard, but after he turned 12, the Hou Mansion removed all these maids.
It's not that the Hou Mansion bullied him because he was young, but that all the children in the Hou Mansion are like this. Before reaching the eighth level, those who practice martial arts are most taboo about losing their virginity.
But practicing martial arts brings vitalityFang Gang's, surrounded by beautiful maids all day long, will inevitably taste the forbidden fruit and affect his future future.
As soon as Xia Chen stepped out of the courtyard, a beautiful woman in her mid-twenties wearing a green Luo Shang skirt walked towards Xia Chen.
"Bizhu!"
Xia Chen knew this woman.
"Third Young Master, the master and his wife are calling you over."
Bizhu stopped in front of Xia Chen and bowed with respect. She was not as arrogant and arrogant as in the TV series, looking down on this young master who was a little transparent in the Hou family.
